proposals.title: Martin Haugh — Forwards, Swaps, Futures and Options (2016)
proposals.use: Further reading on dated carry replication, contractual forward value and swap cash decomposition; Sections1–3. Examples and exercises here are original.
proposals.verification: Primary author course PDF retrieved; Sections1–3 inspected. Historical teaching document, not current market conventions.

proposals.title: CME Group — Money Calculations for CME-cleared Futures and Options (11 June 2015)
proposals.use: Dated primary specification of settlement variation, signed quantities and product-dependent rounding. The chapter uses an invented exact-arithmetic margin ledger.
proposals.verification: Official PDF body retrieved; pages1–3 inspected for variation cash, sign and rounding. No assertion of current exchange requirements.
